description: Geocode a US street address with the Census Geocoder (keyless). Accepts a one-line address OR structured street/city/state/zip parts. Returns the normalized matched address, longitude/latitude, and Census geographies (state, county, tract, block, congressional district) with GEOIDs. No match returns an explicit not-found message.

address.description: One-line address, e.g. '4600 Silver Hill Rd, Washington, DC 20233'. Provide this OR the structured parts.

state.description: Two-letter state code for a structured query (e.g. 'DC').

street.description: Street line for a structured query (e.g. '4600 Silver Hill Rd').

zip.description: ZIP code for a structured query.

name: geocode_address
